note: Traveler archetypes. Advice is pre-generated once per archetype per ship (the cliffnotes cost model), stored, and served free. At runtime the customer's interview answers map to the nearest archetype. 'traveler' is the description fed to the AI; 'match' are hints for the runtime mapper (party/budget/priorities). Add/refine archetypes and regenerate.

archetypes.label: First-time couple, wants the ocean, sensitive stomach
archetypes.traveler: a couple, their second cruise, comfortable budget, want to wake up to the ocean, one of them gets a little queasy and both are light sleepers

archetypes.label: Couple treating themselves to a great balcony
archetypes.traveler: a couple treating themselves, want a really nice ocean-view balcony (not a full suite), value peace and quiet, no kids

archetypes.label: Anniversary splurge, no ceiling
archetypes.traveler: a couple celebrating an anniversary with no budget ceiling, want the best room on the ship — space, a real ocean balcony, and the suite perks

archetypes.label: Family, kids, wants the action
archetypes.traveler: a family with two young kids, comfortable budget, want to be near all the action and don't mind noise, need a room that sleeps four

archetypes.label: Budget family that needs room
archetypes.traveler: a family of four on a lean budget who still need enough room for everyone, view matters less than price and space

archetypes.label: Quiet-seeking retirees
archetypes.traveler: a retired couple, comfortable budget, above all want peace and quiet and easy rest, happy with a calm view, both light sleepers

archetypes.label: Value hunter who still wants the sea
archetypes.traveler: a couple watching their budget who still want an ocean view and are open to a smart trade-off to save money

archetypes.label: Solo first-timer, budget-minded
archetypes.traveler: a solo traveler on their first cruise, keeping costs down, wants a pleasant room but is mindful of the single-supplement

archetypes.label: Solo traveling with a group
archetypes.traveler: a solo traveler sailing as part of a larger group, wants to be near the group and near the action, comfortable budget

archetypes.label: Group that wants to stay together
archetypes.traveler: a group traveling together, comfortable budget, care most about being near each other and near everything, view is secondary

archetypes.label: Experienced cruisers, know they want a real ocean balcony
archetypes.traveler: experienced cruisers, comfortable budget, know exactly what they want: a real ocean balcony in a steady mid-ship spot, no gimmicks

archetypes.label: Motion is the whole concern
archetypes.traveler: a couple where seasickness is the top concern, comfortable budget, want the steadiest possible room and a real ocean view if it doesn't cost them stability
